configuration.routing: Hard author/date constraints shift context weight to the original message.
configuration.normalization: Clamp embedding cosine to [0,1]; TF-IDF is already [0,1]; no per-query min/max rescaling.
configuration.metadata: Explicit sender, chat-date and requested message-type filters; uncertain person mention gets a bonus; topic names do not.
configuration.context_policy: Filter and credit the current message only; neighbors may have other authors/dates.
configuration.query_text_policy: Original raw query is used for all similarity channels.
configuration.tie_break: message ID ascending for exactly equal scores
configuration.candidate_policy: Score the entire corpus, then intersect hard constraints before top K.
configuration.tuning: Four general profiles measured on the same 40 queries; subsequent general constraint experiments are in results/tuning_notes.md. These are development-set metrics.

semantic.context_order: timestamp then message ID; no thread/episode labels used
semantic.token_budget_policy: Trim longest neighbors first, then current only if it alone exceeds budget
semantic.original_text_policy: Always preserve and return exact current message text
semantic.score: NumPy cosine of normalized query and document embeddings
semantic.tie_break: message ID ascending for exactly equal scores
semantic.zero_score_policy: Return top K cosine matches; blank query returns []
semantic.tuning: One fixed contextual configuration, selected before scoring; no label-based tuning

contextual.context_order: timestamp then message ID; no thread/episode labels used
contextual.token_budget_policy: Trim longest neighbors first, then current only if it alone exceeds budget
contextual.original_text_policy: Always preserve and return exact current message text
contextual.score: NumPy cosine of normalized query and document embeddings
contextual.tie_break: message ID ascending for exactly equal scores
contextual.zero_score_policy: Return top K cosine matches; blank query returns []
contextual.tuning: One fixed contextual configuration, selected before scoring; no label-based tuning

lexical.tie_break: message ID ascending for exactly equal scores
lexical.zero_score_policy: omit zero-score messages; empty/OOV query returns []
lexical.empty_channel_policy: zero contribution; weights are not renormalized
lexical.tuning: Fixed defaults chosen before scoring; no evaluation-driven tuning
